title: CVS Health (CVS) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
transcript:
Management unveils a plan to split the company into two public businesses.

Image source: The Motley Fool.

DATE

Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026

CALL PARTICIPANTS

TAKEAWAYS

Need a quote from a Motley Fool analyst? Email[email protected]

RISKS

SUMMARY

CVS Health Corporation(CVS-11.48%)announced a definitive plan to separate into two independent, publicly traded companies by the first half of 2028. The first entity, which will retain the CVS Health name, will comprise the Aetna insurance business, Caremark pharmacy services, specialty pharmacy, and care delivery assets including Oak Street Health and Signify Health. The second entity, to be named CVS Pharmacy, will encompass retail pharmacy operations, mail-order pharmacy, MinuteClinic, and the Health 100 technology platform. Management reported that the separation is intended to provide each company with sharper focus, tailored capital allocation strategies, and greater operational agility. The transaction is expected to be tax-free for U.S. federal income tax purposes and remains subject to board approval and customary closing conditions.
